codeReview.summary: The implementation correctly adds sensor_a_temp, sensor_b_temp, and hold_timer_minutes fields to StatusUpdate with proper dual-interpretation of offset 7. The parsing logic is clean: is_hold determines whether offset 7 yields hold_timer_minutes or sensor_a_temp, and is_ab_temps determines whether offset 8 yields sensor_b_temp. All four validation assertions (VAL-PROTO-001 through VAL-PROTO-004) are covered by 14 well-structured tests. Temperature scale divisor is correctly applied. All existing StatusUpdate struct literal constructions across the workspace (launa-core, launa-mqtt, launa-sim) were updated.

issues.description: The hold mode check uses `payload[0] == 0x05` and A/B temps check uses `payload[0] == 0x14`, but does not account for Test Mode (0x17) or other possible spa states. In Test Mode, offset 7 interpretation is undefined. This is a minor concern because: (1) the existing `is_hold` field already used `payload[0] == 0x05` before this feature, (2) Test Mode is rare in production, and (3) the current behavior (treating Test Mode as normal mode for sensor_a_temp) is a reasonable default. No action needed.

The feature description mentions 'offset 0 bit 2' for is_hold, but the implementation correctly uses `payload[0] == 0x05` (the full spa state byte). This matches the protocol documentation in docs/protocol.md where offset 0 is the Spa State field (ST) with value 0x05 indicating Hold Mode. The precondition in features.json was slightly misleading, but the implementation is correct.
